prompt: I have a tendency to keep browser tabs open. I currently have over 200 of them open at this time. What could I do to avoid keeping so many tabs open at all time?
response: To minimize the number of tabs you open, consider closing unnecessary tabs and focusing on one or two tabs at a time. You can also use the browser's built-in features like minimizing open tabs to save on screen space. This approach will help you maintain a more efficient use of your computer's resources.
